entities.title: retire-sessions.sql is a migration outside worker/migrations/
entities.summary: The file that drops the old sessions table sits beside schema.sql, where the migration check and the deploy gate do not look.
entities.compromise: It was written as a one-off command in the README's sign-in move, before the repository's migration convention; Gambit has no worker/migrations/ folder.
entities.cost: Nothing records whether production has run it, and the next migration has no numbered file to follow.
acceptanceCriteria: The drop is a numbered file in games/chess/worker/migrations/ (or recorded as applied and removed), as docs/database-migrations.md describes.

origin.description: Its comment, against docs/database-migrations.md and .github/scripts/migration-gate.sh's paths.

entities.title: auth.ts names the wrong cookie
entities.summary: auth.ts's opening comment says the cookie is games_session; the code reads site_session.
entities.compromise: The comment kept an earlier name when the cookie changed.
entities.cost: A reader looking for the session cookie looks for one that is never set.
acceptanceCriteria: The comment names site_session, as createAuth does.

origin.description: The opening comment, against the AUTH constant.
